audit.why: Rumble owning 1-3 and the late game, Akali taking 4-6 and first item, matches 50.8% Emerald+ over 1524 games and both on-disk charts, and agrees with the mirror rumble__akali.json. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was untouched template text and breakdown.spikes gave The Equalizer no cooldown and Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: The Equalizer is 130/105/80s over 1750 range - a long enough cooldown that surviving one is a real window, which is worth saying. Twilight Shroud is also not learnable before level 3.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and breakdown.spikes rebuilt on the 130s and level 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly says Twilight Shroud makes Rumble unable to keep Flamespitter on you and that 'the trade resets clean', and Electro Harpoon's magic-resist shred is never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes Akali invisible and unselectable by spells and attacks. Flamespitter is a cone, Electro Harpoon is a skillshot and The Equalizer is a ground zone - none of them select a target, so all three keep damaging her inside the smoke. She breaks his aim, not his damage, and the mirror entry rumble__akali.json makes the identical correction from his side. Separately, Electro Harpoon reduces Magic Resist and he carries two charges on a 0.5s recast, so the second harpoon hits into shredded MR - which is exactly why the 'Build MR' advice needs the caveat and why his follow-up hurts more than it looks.
audit.corrected: content wants.you[0], whys[3] and mid now say Shroud breaks his aim but not his damage; report[5].t carries the harpoon MR shred; report[11].t and dontsFull[1].d state that the smoke does not stop the zone.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[1].t, report[5].t, report[9].t, content whys[5], spikes[2].text and wants.you[2] all tell you to bait or track Scrap Shield.
audit.why: Scrap Shield is a flat 6 seconds. It is never down in any meaningful sense, so 'commit when his shield is empty' is advice that never fires. The real window is his Heat bar: at 100% he Overheats and cannot cast at all, which breakdown.cooldowns already says correctly - the rest of the page just did not follow it.
audit.corrected: report[1].t, report[5].t, report[9].t, dosFull[2].t and content whys[5], spikes[2].text and wants.you[2] now key on Overheat and state the 6s so the reader knows why Scrap Shield is not the plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] correctly says to build MR, but nothing warns that his MR shred works against it.
audit.why: Electro Harpoon reduces Magic Resist on hit and he holds two charges, so an MR item is worth less against Rumble than against a champion without shred. That belongs on the page next to the MR advice.

edits.before: This is your stretch. Once you have Shroud (W) you can finally go invisible mid-trade — Rumble can't aim Electro-Harpoon or keep the Flamespitter cone glued to you, and the trade resets clean. At 6 you flip the lane: R's first dash chained off E, then the missing-health re-dash from any angle, lets you leap onto him from outside his Equalizer (R) line and execute before its ticks matter. Bait his Scrap Shield (W) and read his heat bar, then commit E-Q-R while his Flamespitter is down and the shield is empty. This level-6-to-first-item window is your only real ownership stretch — use it before he out-scales you.
edits.after: This is your stretch. Once you have Shroud (W) you can go invisible mid-trade — Rumble loses his target lock and his aim, though the Flamespitter cone and Electro-Harpoon still damage you inside the smoke. At 6 you flip the lane: R's first dash chained off E, then the missing-health re-dash from any angle, lets you leap onto him from outside his Equalizer (R) line and execute before its ticks matter. Read his heat bar and commit E-Q-R on the Overheat, while Flamespitter is down. This level-6-to-first-item window is your only real ownership stretch — use it before he out-scales you.

notes: This entry sold Twilight Shroud as an answer to Rumble's damage. It is not: Flamespitter, Electro Harpoon and The Equalizer are all non-selected, so the smoke costs him his aim and nothing else. The mirror entry rumble__akali.json reached the same conclusion from his side, so both pages now agree. The 'bait Scrap Shield' advice was the other systemic problem — it is a flat 6s and is never down.
